item.title: NHL Rumors: Blue Jackets Avoiding Rental Players At Deadline
item.description: The Columbus Blue Jackets have surged back into the playoff conversation, but don’t expect a typical deadline push. Despite sitting just four points out of a wild-card spot and riding a stunning turnaround under head coach Rick Bowness, general manager Don Waddell is making one thing clear: Columbus isn’t interested in sacrificing assets for short-term rental players. item.title: Surprising Development in Logan Stanley’s Trade Market
item.description: 6-foot-7 defenseman Logan Stanley is having a breakout season for the Winnipeg Jets. His two-year, $2.5 million contract ($1.25M AAV) is coming to an end, and he'll be due for a raise.
